description: Move a wiki page, with every page beneath it: 'position' 'above' or 'below' a sibling ('targetId'), 'append' to put it inside 'targetId' as its last child, or 'top' to put it at the top of a space — its own, or another project's by 'toSpaceKey'. The order among siblings is kept: list it with get_wiki_page's children. A target in another space moves the page into that space too. Into another project's space you must be able to write in both and see every page that goes; refused for the space's home page, for a page holding a secret or writing claims, and when the space already has one of the titles — the answer names them. Its files, comments, versions, approvals and reading go with it; a person who cannot open the new project is taken off its restrictions and reading list, and 'dropped' / 'droppedReaders' say who. Links by title are rewritten to keep naming the same pages ('relinked'). Requires permission to edit the page where it is and where it goes.

message.description: Short note for the page history.

position.description: 'above', 'below', 'append' (inside the target, last) or 'top' (the top of a space).

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

targetId.description: The page to move it above, below or inside. Not for 'top'.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

toSpaceKey.description: With 'top': the space to put it at the top of — another project's moves it there. Its own space when left out.

name: move_wiki_page
title: Move wiki page
